findings.augmented_variant: At restartCycle>0 with augmentation enabled, runtime selects augmented P/AP, augmented RAP/LU/pivots/valid and modeCount. The extra mode carries (control, physicsSubstep, Newton, restartCycle) generation; mismatched generation is inadmissible.
findings.base_variant: Runtime selects base mode count at restartCycle=0, but if restart augmentation storage is enabled, modeStride is augmentedModeCount even for the base view. A decoder must slice only modeCount columns while honoring that stride.
findings.cgls_scope: CGLS source149 uses a separate nodal block3 S: initialization applies S^T to A^T b, each forward product applies A(S p), and each residual gradient applies S^T A^T r. It does not invoke the regional RAP map inside CGLS.
findings.regional_action: source selector 3/4 block-RAP action is z = P c + B (r - AP c), c solves (P^T AP)c=P^T r; B is marked per-node 3x3 inverse block, falling back to componentwise inverse diagonal when row0.w <= 0.5.
findings.regional_transpose: No regional RAP transpose kernel is present in source149. The independent algebraic transpose must reverse the composition and solve RAP^T; do not reuse RAP solve or assume symmetry.
findings.selector5_graph_action: The graph path forms c=R^-1 P^T r, patch RHS E(r-AP c), and patch correction D_p times that RHS. D_p is the production one-refinement map from stored LU solve F_p and original patch matrix A_p: D_p b=F_p b+F_p(b-A_p F_p b). The apply kernel gathers each patch-node correction and divides each global node by nodeCoverage, then adds P c. Thus H=G D E and S=H+(P-H AP)R^-1 P^T. Its algebraic transpose is H^T+P R^-T(P^T-(AP)^T H^T), with H^T=E^T D^T G^T and D_p^T=2F_p^T-F_p^T A_p^T F_p^T in exact arithmetic. This graph map is source-audited but no selector5 same-generation capture is present in this package, so it is not implemented or qualified here.
findings.selector5_required_capture: A rigorous selector5 replay needs one same-generation sidecar with graph patch descriptors [patchNodeOffset,nodeCount,matrixOffset,pivotOffset], sorted global patch-node IDs, graph row map, node-to-patch CSR offsets/values, per-node coverage, original pre-LU patch matrices, in-place LU, final row pivots, factor-valid words, effective P/AP, selected base or augmented RAP LU/pivots/validity, modeCount/modeStride, candidate node fixed/free tags, selected/healthy status, and source/world/program/device plus control/substep/microtick/micro-generation/Newton/dt and candidate-history digests. Patch RHS/coefficient dumps are input-specific and cannot stand in for this map. An arbitrary-vector native output would be needed to verify native forward action; source149 has no selector5 transpose kernel, so transpose parity remains CPU algebraic only.
findings.unsupported: This package implements CPU references and tests only for selector 3/4 block-RAP and diagonal fallback. Selector 5 is explicitly unsupported pending the source-bound same-generation capture described above; no generic S test or another generation is used as selector5 evidence.
